name: Exult in Violence
text:
Requirements You critically hit an enemy this turn.

---
You let out a war cry as your blow lands true, and judgment descends on an enemy. A pillar of light deals ternarygte(@actor.level,17,10,ternarygte(@actor.level,12,7,4))d6 spirit damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC to a different enemy selected at random within 30 feet of the target struck. This damage increases to 7d6 if you are 12th level and 10d6 if you are 17th level.
